newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-EBRD, LPA ASKED FOR UNIBANKA POSTPONEMENT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-EBRD, LPA ASKED FOR UNIBANKA POSTPONEMENT.

text.p: Unibanka said on Thursday that its biggest shareholders, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), and the privatisation agency (LPA) asked for the postponement of the bank's extraordinary meeting.

The central depository earlier announced that Unibanka postponed its meeting from April 21 to June 2. The meeting was due to consider the merger of Unibanka and Zemes Banka, which was unexpectedly cancelled last month.

"The (privatisation) agency and the EBRD, our biggest shareholders said that they had to coordinate a number of issues," an Unibanka spokeswoman told Reuters, explaining the reason for the postponement.

The EBRD backed the cancellation of the merger but the privatisation agency was unhappy that it was not even informed by the Unibanka board of the end of the merger plans. It has said it still thinks the linking of the banks should take place.
